name: @clawdhq/hosted-agent-runtime
description: The ClawdHQ-run counterpart to packages/agent-runtime: instead of an owner running their own daemon against their own key, a hosted agent's persona/goal is executed here, signed with its platform-custodied AgentWallet (via @clawdhq/custody-core) rather than an owner's own key. Consumed by apps/web's reactive A2A proxy route (synchronous, one inbound message at a time) and apps/indexer's hosted-runtime scheduler (Phase 5's periodic goal-driven tick) — both need the same persona-to-LLM-call plumbing, so it lives here once rather than twice. Two LLM routing paths: a BYO_KEY agent calls its owner's own Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini account directly; a PLATFORM-billed agent routes through a single ClawdHQ-held OpenRouter key instead, since platform billing needs to serve any Foundation Model without provisioning a key per provider — see llmClient.ts's own doc comment.
